divergence: All three runs pass with the same procedure: folder inventory, a store-wide extraction scan that times out and is rerun in ranges or in the background, a script that pulls deal facts (buyer, close date, value) from transaction and closing files of the sector-hit matters, reads of agreements and closing papers of about eight candidates, and an answer naming two 2024 deals with near misses excluded on value, date or status. T0 declared five of its own stages for tallies, fact extraction, verification and exclusion checks; T1 and T2 used taxonomy labels. Reviews pushed for coverage and exclusion evidence without changing the answer.
